approach_logistics.trailhead: Downey Creek Trailhead (Trail #768, Suiattle River Road)
approach_logistics.trailheadDirection: From Darrington, drive Highway 530 to the Suiattle River Road (Forest Road 26) and turn east; the trailhead is in a parking lot just past the Downey Creek bridge, about 20 miles from Highway 530. Since February 2026 the road has been closed to vehicles at milepost 4 (order in place to January 2028), so the last miles must be covered on foot or by bike.

pins.name: Downey Creek Trailhead
pins.note: Remote 2-day approach: Downey/Bachelor Creek trail to Itswoot Ridge, then over the Dome-Chickamin col and across the Chickamin Glacier to the Gunsight Range.
pins.directions: From Darrington, drive north on SR 530 about 8 miles to the Suiattle River Road (FS Road 26) and follow it east about 20 miles to the Downey Creek Trailhead at about 1,440 ft, just past the Downey Creek bridge. Park on the south side of the road; the trail starts on the north side. A Northwest Forest Pass or the $5 day fee is required to park.

pins.name: Middle Peak (Gunsight Range)
pins.note: Gunrunner (IV 5.10-, 18 pitches) traverses all four Gunsight summits; Middle Peak is one of the four climbed en route. Distance is approximate given the remote, glaciated approach.
pins.directions: Hike the Downey Creek Trail to the Bachelor Creek crossing and follow the climbers' path up Bachelor Creek to Cub Lake and Itswoot Ridge. Rope up for the Dome Glacier to the Dome-Chickamin col, then cross the Chickamin Glacier beneath the Gunsight peaks to the north end of the ridge. Climb the crest over the Northeast and North peaks to Gunsight Notch, then a dihedral on the east side of the crest to Middle Peak.
